description.en: Garlic, olive oil and chilli: dinner in fifteen minutes.
description.ro: Usturoi, ulei de măsline și ardei iute: cină în cincisprezece minute.
description.ar: ثوم وزيت زيتون وفلفل حار: عشاء في خمس عشرة دقيقة.

steps: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted water until just al dente. Keep a cup of the pasta water.
Warm the oil with the garlic over low heat until pale gold, then add the chilli.
Add the drained spaghetti and a splash of pasta water and toss for 1 minute.
Finish with the parsley and serve at once.
